noPermission.title: In-line checks are not yours to record
noPermission.body: They are recorded by the inspector and the team leader. Ask your team leader.

camera.error: The camera does not start. Scan or type the code.

firstPiece.label: Scan the first bundle
firstPiece.hint: The bundle the first piece is cut, sewn or made from.

cutting.label: Scan a bundle of the lay
cutting.hint: Its pieces are checked against the pattern.

eol.label: Scan the bundle at the end of the line
eol.hint: Then Pass, or Defect to send it back.

wrong.notBundle: {code} is not a bundle ticket. Scan the bundle's ticket.
wrong.notFound: {code} is not a bundle of this site.
wrong.notOnTablet: {code} is not on this tablet. Check it when the network is back.

defects.offline: The defects are not on this tablet: they come with the network.
defects.error: The defects did not load. Try again.
defects.empty: No defects are set up for this stage. Ask the office (Quality › Defects & dispositions).

kindHint.FIRST_PIECE: The run waits until it is approved
kindHint.ROVING: Green, amber or red per operation
kindHint.END_OF_LINE: Pass, or send a defect back

kindHeld.online: This needs the network: it is signed or recorded at once.
kindHeld.noLine: This tablet shows no line: the office sets the line of this station.

operation.title: Which operation waits for this first piece?
operation.hint: Until it is approved, no other bundle of the run is worked there.

held.critical: A critical check failed: {check}. Reject the first piece.

done.approvedText: The run is free at {operation}: the operation screens lift their hold now.
done.rejectedText: The run keeps waiting. A new first piece is asked.

fp.holds: The run waits at this operation until the first piece is approved.
fp.noPlan: No inspection plan applies: look at the piece, then approve or reject it.
fp.office: {check}: answered in the office (no typing on the floor).

sign.noPlan: No plan: you looked at the piece.
sign.approveMeaning: You approve the first piece of work order {number} at {operation}: the run starts there.
sign.rejectMeaning: You reject the first piece of work order {number}: the run keeps waiting for a new one.

cutting.recut_one: {count} piece is recut: the cutting office makes the recut ticket.
cutting.recut_other: {count} pieces are recut: the cutting office makes the recut ticket.

empty.title: Nothing runs on this line today
empty.body: Operations show here once a work order is allocated to the line or worked at its stations.

roving.title: The line's operations

held.greenWithDefects: Green means every piece is right: one wrong is amber, two or more red.
held.critical: A critical defect is always red.

roving.perOperation: Recorded for the operation, never for a person.

eol.sendBackOnline: Sending back needs the network: it opens a rework order at once.
eol.offline: Offline: a pass is saved on this tablet and sent later.

held.operation: Pick the operation that caused it

eol.subject: {defective} of {pieces}
eol.perOperation: Charged to the operation, never to a person.

line.none: This tablet shows no line: the DHU of a line shows on a line's tablet.

open.none: No first piece waits for approval.
open.title: First pieces waiting

done.reworkNotOpened: The rework order did not open: tell your team leader.

FIRST_PIECE_OPEN.message: A first piece of this run is open already.
FIRST_PIECE_OPEN.fix: Open it from the list of first pieces waiting, decide it, or ask the office to cancel it.

ALREADY_APPROVED.message: The first piece of this run is approved already: nothing waits for it.
ALREADY_APPROVED.fix: Record a roving or end-of-line check instead.

WORK_ORDER_NOT_RUNNING.message: This work order is not running.
WORK_ORDER_NOT_RUNNING.fix: Check a work order the line is running.

NOT_OPEN.message: This check is decided or cancelled already: it never changes.

NO_PLAN.message: This check runs on no plan: it has no checklist to answer.

PLAN_RESULTS.message: The plan is not answered yet, or a critical check failed.
PLAN_RESULTS.fix: Answer the plan first, or reject the first piece.

NOT_FOUND.fix: Go back and read the line again.

FLOOR_NOT_READY.message: Checks are held at this site until its floor is ready.

BUNDLE_NOT_ACTIVE.message: This bundle is voided or replaced.

MORE_THAN_BUNDLE.message: More pieces than the bundle holds.
MORE_THAN_BUNDLE.fix: Send back at most the bundle's pieces.

NOT_A_REWORK_REASON.message: That rework reason is not active.
NOT_A_REWORK_REASON.fix: Ask the office (Production › Floor rules & codes).

NOT_OF_CELL.message: The bundle is not of this colour and size.

REWORK_AT_LATER.message: The rework is at an operation after the one that found it.

NEXT_REPORTED.message: The next operation has taken the bundle already.
NEXT_REPORTED.fix: Ask your team leader to open the rework.
